Write six things tonight. Tomorrow, do only the first one.

Kevin explains a simple daily method. List the six most important things for tomorrow in order of importance, then put the list in front of you at work and look only at the first item.

No interruptions, no phone calls, no mail. Stay on it until it is finished or there is nothing more you can do with it today. Only then move on to the next one.

What would change if you gave one task your full focus tomorrow?
